tasks.summary: Keep timeout configuration backwards compatible and expressed in seconds.
tasks.answer:
### Context
The API currently sets timeout_seconds to 30 seconds; its retries value is 3 (`{source}:1-1`). The UI has a separate seconds-based setting.

### Options
Keep two independent values or introduce a shared timeout_seconds setting with an adapter for timeoutSeconds.

### Trade-offs
A shared value reduces drift but requires a compatibility adapter during migration.

### Recommendation
Use seconds throughout and retain the default of 30 seconds. Accept the existing UI field until all callers migrate.

### Risks
A milliseconds conversion or early removal of the old field could change request timeouts.

### Implementation outline
Add the compatibility adapter, migrate each consumer, then test default values, override parity and old-field compatibility without changing public behavior.

### Open questions
Which service owns the configuration artifact, and when can the compatibility field be retired?
